notes.title: Halloween HUB
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes – Halloween Update[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]New Temporary Halloween Hub[/b] – Enjoy the spooky and festive atmosphere of a specially decorated Halloween hub!
[*][b]Updated Awakening Menu[/b] – The Awakening menu has been enhanced for a smoother and more intuitive experience.
[*][b]New Controller Layout Options[/b] – Added the ability to choose between controller layouts for Xbox Series X (XSX), PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch Pro.
[*][b]NPC Interaction Indicator[/b] – An icon now appears to signal when you can speak to an NPC.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and happy gaming!

[u]Improvements:[/u]

- Improved some gamepad compatibility.
- Improved inventory gamepad navigation.
- Improved inventory grid performance (requests less memory resources). The inventory code has been totally revamped. If you find any bugs, please let us know!

[u]Fixes:[/u]

- Fixed an issue where the box selection item wasn't closing after confirmation.

notes.title: Update - French Translation, New Content, and Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] I have tried to complete the French translation. I will correct it based on your feedback.
[*] [b]New Boss: Rinarie Raid[/b]
  [list]
  [*] This boss requires highly optimized gear to defeat.
  [*] Defeating her allows you to craft new weapons and armor.
  [/list]
[*] [b]New NPC: Rinarie[/b]
  [list]
  [*] This NPC allows you to craft equipment from the new raid.
  [/list]
[*] Spells are now color-coded for each type of weapon for easier identification.
[*] Approximate damage specifications for each spell have been added to their descriptions.
[*] New spell for the hammer to reach enemies more quickly.
[*] When selecting an item, you can now use the mouse cursor to assist you.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the crafting menu bug related to NPCs.
[*] Fixed the shield break issue on bosses.
[/list]

[h2]Testing and Information[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you see any errors or inconsistencies in the messages/translations, please report them on Discord.
[*] I am aware that the bow, staff, and fist are the three weapon types that need a revamp as they have fewer spells and gameplay options compared to others.
[*] The player's default expedition was just a test. I focused on boss battles and combat mechanics.
[/list]

Thank you all for your support and feedback! Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
[center][h1]Update Version [b]0.2.1[/b][/h1][/center]

[b]Major Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Migration of development infrastructure from [b]Unreal Engine 4[/b] to [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b].
[*] Revamped shader with animated style for improved shadows and effects.
[*] Total overhaul of the interface management system, eliminating overlaps and enhancing clarity.
[*] Significant enhancements to interfaces with multiple elements redesigned for optimized user experience.
[*] Complete overhaul of the key system with [b]Enhanced Input[/b], offering improved responsiveness and accuracy.
[*] Improved controller usage in menus and gameplay, with compatibility still being optimized.
[*] Customization of spell display based on controller or keyboard usage.
[*] New music for the snowy HUB, creating an immersive atmosphere.


[h3]Modular Dungeons[/h3]

Modular dungeons with adjustable difficulty levels, offering increased rewards based on chosen difficulty.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42384751/59e4d8e903b9a97842607215c760aba3dfe4b57a.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42384751/10dd337c02397e8dbafa75c2c53b0429ba6b7ca3.png[/img]

[h3]Build System[/h3]

Introduction of modular level and character building system, allowing creation of pre-configured builds for better dungeon performance.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42384751/98c23db59b2e50e30d8aebc0a4b5e7eaea1603bf.png[/img]

[*] Revision of lobby member management and lobby state for enhanced multiplayer experience.
[*] Detailed display of dungeon and boss results, highlighting individual team member performances.
[/list]

[b]Developer's Note:[/b]

We want to emphasize that this game is the work of a single developer and this update marks a major playtest. Due to the scope of the changes, issues may arise. We greatly appreciate your patience and feedback as it helps us improve the gaming experience.

[b]Community Action:[/b]

We also encourage our community to get more involved in the game's development. If you're interested in volunteering to translate the game into your language, you can join us on [b]Crowdin[/b].


Thank you for your continued support !

notes.title: Update 2024.02.04
notes.content:
[center][b]Patch Notes[/b][/center]

[b]Code Revamp:[/b] Significant changes to certain code bases have been implemented.
Despite the development of an overlay to facilitate the migration of your inventories and data, I cannot guarantee the absence of potential data loss.
As a result, numerous bugs may arise.

[b]Customizable Auto-Attack:[/b] Weapon auto-attacks are now developed to be customizable in the future.
Currently, only the great sword's auto-attack B has two versions. The menu is accessible via the weapon page, the 3rd tab next to the spells.

[b]Secure Locking:[/b] To prevent dismantling/sacrificing specific equipment, it is now possible to lock your items through the inventory.

[b]Uncap System:[/b] Possibility to uncap equipment by sacrificing duplicate items.
Depending on the rarity of the equipment, uncapping unlocks additional enchantment slots, providing a bonus to the enchantment.

[b]Weapon Appearance:[/b] Added a weapon appearance system; players can assign a specific appearance to their weapon in the Avatar section using the "Ribbon" icon on the "Weapon" slot.
However, to unlock a weapon's appearance, it must be sacrificed and fully uncapped at the "Stylist."

[b]Reworked Inventory:[/b] The core of the inventory system has been significantly revised, with indicators now showing whether an item is "locked" or "equipped."

[b]HUB Prototype:[/b] Added NPC and redeveloped quests. Basic structures have been implemented in the HUB to test ideas.

[b]Demonic Phantom:[/b] Some movements and visual effects have been revised. Players should now have more time to anticipate attacks.

[b]Redeveloped Hitbox System:[/b] A substantial portion has been moved to a C++ layer for better manipulation in the future.
For now, "Ring" shaped hitboxes need to be readjusted to the new version (PS: Demonic Phantom jumps).

[b]Auto-attacks no longer consume "Stamina".[/b]

[b]Exploration with Friendly Fire:[/b] Added the ability to target allies if "Friendly Fire" is enabled.
